'''Oreg''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] main continent of [[Keshtah Minor]] which housed the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s intelligence depository. Documents deposited in the city's depository included [[Prefect of Police]] [[Takara Hilts]]'s report on [[Parlan Spinner]], titled ''[[Enemy of the Order: The record of Parlan Spinner, vandal and would-be revolutionary]]''.
